title: Unified rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow auto-rollback and auto-restore workflow
author: Avery Chen
ci_details: 23 checks passed: build (ok), unit-tests (ok), integration-rollouts (ok), e2e-rollouts (flaky - rerun passed), lint (ok), security-scan (ok)
description: Motivation: improve rollout safety by adding an automated restore path that complements existing auto-rollback logic for canary, A/B and shadow rollouts. This PR introduces an explicit auto-restore controller that can detect successful remediation after an automatic rollback and (optionally) re-attempt a controlled progressive rollout with updated safety gates. Key goals: 1) reduce time-to-recovery for transient infra failures that previously triggered rollbacks; 2) avoid repeated flip-flop by introducing cooldown and quorum checks; 3) extend observability so operators can see why rollbacks/restores happened and what metrics drove them. Changes: - add autorestore controller that listens to rollout events and rollback actions, tracks metric quorums and cooldown windows, and triggers a gated re-rollout when conditions are met - extend autorollback engine to emit richer signals (rollback_reason, remediation_window, metric_quorum_snapshot) - add staged-probe state to rollout state machine to support quarantine and probing windows prior to re-apply - add e2e tests that simulate infra flaps and verify single automatic restore after healthy stabilization - surface new telemetry in Console Rollout Insights and add new alerting rules for repeated flip-flop - CI workflow updates and new unit/integration tests Backwards compatibility: controllers are opt-in via rollout.spec.autoRestore.enabled default=false to be conservative. Existing customers are unaffected until config is flipped. Linear/JIRA: ENG-2156 (auto-restore design), ENG-2190 (e2e coverage). See related PRs: pr-318999 (probing enhancements), pr-246789 (autorollback workflow improvements). Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] e2e simulated flake, [x] docs updated, [x] feature flag gated, [x] telemetry emitted Testing notes: local integration with minikube + simulated latency/failure harness; CI includes e2e rollouts with mock metrics backend; observed one flaky e2e that required test retry - fixed by increasing probe timeout. Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout to staging, run canary across 2 clusters for 48h, enable autoRestore in a small percentage of customers (beta), monitor rollback/restore metrics and operator alerts for 72h before broad enable. Why this matters: many support incidents are caused by transient infra blips that a conservative auto-rollback handles correctly but operators then must manually re-deploy. Auto-restore closes that loop while preserving safety via quorum and cooldown gates.
